title: A document recites a count that its source file does not support
task:
# Task

OVERVIEW.md states how many checks run on every release. registry.json is the source of truth. Count the checks in the registry and decide whether the stated count is consistent with it. Use only the supplied files.
responseInstructions:
Return decision.json with decision ("consistent" or "mismatch"), facts ({"statedCount": integer, "registeredCount": integer}), and citations from both OVERVIEW.md and registry.json.

Write only decision.json. Keep all supplied files unchanged. This is a read-only triage exercise, not an implementation task. Include citations as an array of {"path":"relative/file","quote":"exact source excerpt"}. Quote the relevant source text. Do not claim to have run a command unless you ran it.

files.OVERVIEW.md:
# Release checks

Every release runs all 6 registered checks before publication.
The registry is the source of truth for which checks exist.
